sections.text:
Equipment
 Back wash ver. centrifugal pump

This pump is used to make back 
 wash flow on travel screen trays to clean it from any contaminations.

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I3, which 
 must be carried out every one year as indicated by Y1 in the above title 
 block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy and tested by 
 maintenance manager eng. Abd El Rahman Nasar and revised by maintenance 
 general manager: eng. Omran Abd El Hamid Shoaib 
 approved by Eng.Ahmed Sawan Nubria power station head sector and
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana 
 &, and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil inspection & quality control 
 general director, MPIS coordinator approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagieb 
 inspection & quality control head sector

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves
Complete maintenance tool set.

Straight edge, rugs, cleaning 
 fluid.

Measure vibrations level for bearings. and compare it with the 
 setting value

Check discharge quantity and pressure. and compare it with the setting 
 value

Check Any Leakage from pump& piping flanges and re-tight ( 
 if it is needed )
Measuring bearing temperature .
Check glands for leaking then re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Replace oil of pump
Check wear to impeller and rings
Check wear to shaft and bearing
Replace rubber pads in coupling
Replace gland packing
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint (if it is needed).
Check bolts fixation, then re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Clean external part with compressed air

Check the direction of rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first 
 time.
Open delivery valve gradually after pump operate to its full speed.
Check the temperature of the bearing
Check the oil level in bearing
Check the vibration of the pump
Check discharge quantity and pressure

Introduction
This pump is used to make back 
 wash flow on travel screen trays to clean it from any contaminations.
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I3, which 
 must be carried out every one year as indicated by Y1 in the above title 
 block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Shady Ghazy and tested by 
 maintenance manager eng. Abd El Rahman Nasar and revised by maintenance 
 general manager: eng. Omran Abd El Hamid Shoaib 
 approved by Eng.Ahmed Sawan Nubria power station head sector and
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana 
 &, and certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil inspection & quality control 
 general director, MPIS coordinator approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagieb 
 inspection & quality control head sector
Technical Specifications
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of 
 the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of 
 the pump motor
The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Straight edge, rugs, cleaning 
 fluid.
Work to be 
carried out
Pump in operation
Measure vibrations level for bearings. and compare it with the 
 setting value
Check discharge quantity and pressure. and compare it with the setting 
 value
Check Any Leakage from pump& piping flanges and re-tight ( 
 if it is needed )
Measuring bearing temperature .
Check glands for leaking then re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Pump out of 
operation
Replace oil of pump
Check wear to impeller and rings
Check wear to shaft and bearing
Replace rubber pads in coupling
Replace gland packing
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value
Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint (if it is needed).
Check bolts fixation, then re-tightens it (if it is needed).
Clean external part with compressed air
Starting of pump
Check the direction of rotation of pump before starting the pump for the first 
 time.
Open delivery valve gradually after pump operate to its full speed.
Attendance and checking during 
operation
Check the temperature of the bearing
Check the oil level in bearing
Check the vibration of the pump
Check discharge quantity and pressure
